notes: RBox: a true subproperty changed. Originally a sequel comes later in its series than the work it follows (sequel_of ⊑ precedes_in_series⁻, i.e. 'comes later in the same series than'); the edit makes it a subproperty of 'comes earlier' instead. Re-picked in review: the writer's version added a false subproperty (adapted_from ⊑ sequel_of), whose original was negative, so its delete had nothing real to remove. Instances are clear sequels whatever the axiom says (R1): Carroll's Through the Looking-Glass (1871) follows Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (1865); Montgomery's Anne of Avonlea (1909) follows Anne of Green Gables (1908). Given only the prompt's fact and the original property, 'comes earlier' does not follow (the opposite does), so the original answer is no; with the edited property it follows. New answers: direct yes, both instances yes, balancing 0009 and 0010 (no). Near query: 'is the sequel of' symmetric? (no), which the edit leaves alone and whose answer differs from the new direct answer (R6). 'Comes earlier in the same series than' is precedes_in_series; 'comes later' is its inverse (follows_in_series).
